units.text: INT. CHEESE AGING CAVE - NIGHT
A limestone tunnel hung with lanterns.
Wooden shelves stacked with wheels of cheese, each stamped with a date.
The air is cold, damp, and sharp with ammonia.
Somewhere, water drips.
INSPECTOR HONORIA WYNDHAM-LEE (50s, tailored overcoat, gloves) walks the aisle with a leather satchel, tapping the wheels with a small silver hammer.
Behind her trails FERMIN OKONKWO-DAHL (30s, cheesemonger, rubber apron), who holds a lantern high.
Further back, the owner, MADAME SOLANGE ARQUETTE (60s, shawl, a wedge of cheese in her fist), muttering as she chews.
A fourth figure, ROLLO PINKERTON (40s, apprentice, nervous grin), drifts at the end of the line, tidying shelves nobody asked him to tidy.
I'll be quick. Where was Monsieur Brisard found?
units.name: HONORIA

units.text: Between those two racks. Behind the Gruyère.
units.name: FERMIN

units.text: Face up?
units.name: HONORIA

units.text: Face down.
units.name: FERMIN

units.text: In the rind?
units.name: HONORIA

units.text: In the rind.
units.name: FERMIN

units.text: Forty years I have made this cheese.
units.name: SOLANGE

units.text: Madame Arquette?
units.name: HONORIA

units.text: Forty years and never a murder.
units.name: SOLANGE

units.text: We aren't calling it that yet.
units.name: HONORIA

units.text: You didn't say "accident."
units.name: SOLANGE

units.text: Honoria crouches by the rack.
She runs a glove along the wooden slats and holds it to the light: a streak of blue-green mold.
Rollo.
units.name: HONORIA

units.text: Yes, Inspector?
units.name: ROLLO

units.text: When did you last wash these shelves?
units.name: HONORIA

units.text: Tuesday.
units.name: ROLLO

units.text: This mold is a week old.
units.name: HONORIA

units.text: I might have missed a spot.
units.name: ROLLO

units.text: Rollo, did you see Monsieur Brisard on Tuesday?
units.name: HONORIA

units.text: No.
units.name: ROLLO

units.text: You did. You gave him his lunch.
units.name: FERMIN

units.text: That was Monday.
units.name: ROLLO

units.text: Monday, Tuesday. All the same in a cave.
units.name: SOLANGE

units.text: Everyone stay where you are. Fermin, the lantern lower. There.
units.name: HONORIA

units.text: The light drops.
On the stone floor, almost invisible, a trail of fine white powder leads away down the tunnel.
Now that is interesting.
units.name: HONORIA
